label: Salary negotiation
counterpart_role: a hiring manager / HR lead at a technology company
user_role: a candidate negotiating a job offer
default_goal: Get a base salary of ₹12 LPA for a software role, offered ₹9 LPA
default_context: I have a competing offer, strong internship experience and market data showing ₹11-13 LPA for this role.
opening_hint: Welcome the candidate warmly, restate the offer and its figure, and signal that it is competitive.
